newsitem.title: USA: "Island of Dr. Moreau" opens at top of box office.
newsitem.headline: "Island of Dr. Moreau" opens at top of box office.

text.p: "The Island of Dr. Moreau" overcame some of the worst reviews of the year to open at the top of the U.S. box office with an estimated gross of $9.0 million at the weekend.

Marlon Brando and Val Kilmer star in the latest big-screen adaptation of the H.G. Wells science-fiction novel, a troubled project that saw the firing of one director and the departure of one of the stars.
According to a Variety magazine poll of critics in New York, Los Angeles, Chicago and Washington D.C., only two liked the movie, while 17 did not and 13 were mixed.
John Frankenheimer directed the movie, replacing Richard Stanley who reportedly had differences with Kilmer. After his departure, actor Rob Morrow left and was replaced by David Thewlis.

Slipping to second place for the Friday to Sunday period was "Tin Cup" with $8.8 million, according to Exhibitor Relations Co. Inc. The Kevin Costner golfing comedy has a 10-day gross of $23.9 million.

Opening in third with $7.4 million was "A Very Brady Sequel", the second movie based on the Brady Bunch television series. "A Time To Kill" was fifth with $6.2 million followed by "Jack" with $5.9 million.
